Package org.geysermc.paletter.item.component

Interface WireOnlyItemComponent

All Superinterfaces:
ItemComponent
All Known Implementing Classes:
FrameCount, MiningSpeed, RenderOffsets
public sealed interface WireOnlyItemComponent extends ItemComponent permits RenderOffsets, MiningSpeed, FrameCount
Hand-written item components for wire fields Bedrock clients read but add-on JSON cannot set (or no longer can): they have no source in the component model, so they are not generated. They go through the same CustomItem and compile path as the generated components, and are encoded per protocol window by Paletter.
  • RenderOffsets: minecraft:render_offsets, retired from the add-on format
  • MiningSpeed: item_properties.mining_speed
  • FrameCount: item_properties.frame_count
